    AI Overview
    Yes, as of March 2025, Tiger Woods is in a relationship with Vanessa Trump, the former wife of Donald Trump Jr. The couple went public with their romance on Instagram, sharing photos together and expressing that "life is better with you by my side". They have since been spotted together at events like the 2026 TGL Finals. 
    Key Details About Their Relationship: 
    • Relationship Status: They confirmed their relationship in March 2025 after months of rumors, with reports suggesting they started dating around Thanksgiving 2024.
    • Public Appearances: Vanessa has supported Tiger at golf events, including his TGL debut and other competitions, and they recently celebrated his 50th birthday together
      .
    • Background: Vanessa Trump was married to Donald Trump Jr. from 2005 to 2018 and has five children.
    • Connection: Their relationship reportedly grew through their shared connection to golf, particularly through her daughter, Kai Trump.
    • Privacy: The couple has expressed a desire for privacy regarding their relationship. 
    Before this relationship, Woods was famously linked to Erica Herman for several years until 2022.
